<p>Right before <a href="http://eadm.eu/save-the-date-spudm-august-20th-24th-2023-save-the-date/">SPUDM29</a> in Vienna we will have the yearly EGPROC meeting  between August 18th and 19th, 2023 organised by <a href="https://www.wu.ac.at/en/cobe/team/prof-dr-susann-fiedler/">Susann Fiedler</a> at the <a href="https://www.wu.ac.at/">Vienna University of Economics and Business</a>. </p>

<p>Looking forward seeing you and your process tracing projects there!</p>
